verdict.rationale: Stripe Tax is an API-driven service, so issuing scoped or least-privilege credentials for an agent is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents restricted keys, permission scoping, or per-agent credentials. The MCP server and CLI probes belong to other stories and do not show credential scoping.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
